_note: sound = how Buddy imitates the animal with its voice. If a CC0/public-domain recording named <id>.wav exists in the configured sounds folder it is played as well. fact = one short, true, child-friendly fact.

animals.fact: Cows give us milk, and they love to munch on green grass all day.
Dogs have a super nose. They can smell things we cannot smell at all.
Cats purr when they are happy. Purrrr, purrrr.
A lion's roar is so loud, you could hear it from very, very far away.
Every tiger has its own stripes. No two tigers look exactly the same.
Elephants use their long trunk like a hand, to pick up food and to spray water.

animals.sound: Ooh ooh, aah aah! Ooh ooh, aah aah!
animals.fact: Monkeys love bananas, and they can swing from tree to tree.
Ducks have special feathers that keep them dry, even when they swim.
Sheep give us soft wool, that we use to make warm sweaters.
Baby goats are called kids, just like you!
Horses can sleep standing up!
Pigs are very clever animals. They roll in mud to stay cool.
Hens lay eggs, and baby chicks say cheep cheep.
The rooster crows early in the morning, like an alarm clock!
Donkeys are very strong, and they can carry heavy things.
Baby frogs are called tadpoles, and they live in water with little tails.
Snakes have no legs. They slide on their tummy!
Bees make sweet honey from the flowers.
Owls stay awake at night, and they can turn their heads almost all the way around.
Crows are very smart birds. They can solve puzzles!
Some parrots can copy the words that people say.
The peacock is the national bird of India, with beautiful blue and green feathers.
Birds build nests to keep their eggs safe and warm.
Mice are tiny, and they can squeeze through very small holes.
Wolves live together in a family called a pack.
Some bears sleep all winter long. That is called hibernating.
Camels live in the desert, and they can walk a long time without drinking water.
The blue whale is the biggest animal in the whole world.
The koel sings a sweet song in the summer.
Squirrels hide nuts to eat later. Sometimes they forget where they hid them!
